THE BIGGEST SLUCH OF THE EUROPEAN CONTINENT!

The richness of Holland is its commercial force on the water. Year after year Holland is forced to spend many thousands of guilders for all kinds of waterworks and Dutch engineers are famous in all countries for their great knowledge in building up sluices.
